text_simplified: This text discusses the importance of ṣadaqah (voluntary charity) and its impact on the tarbiyah (Islamic upbringing) of children in Islamic values. It highlights that ṣadaqah purifies the soul and increases barakah (blessing) in wealth. It also advises teaching children ṣadaqah from a young age to raise them with the qualities of giving and generosity.
